faqs.q: Sec. 98-65. - Suspension or revocation of license.
faqs.a:
The enforcement officer shall have the power, at any time, upon violation by any holder
               of a license as provided for in this article or any of the regulations lawfully prescribed
               hereunder by the enforcement officer, or for violation of any provisions of this Code
               or state statute, to suspend or revoke any such license after a hearing before the
               enforcement officer. Any device or method employed by the holder of a license to evade
               the payment of the tax provided for by this article shall be sufficient cause for
               suspension or revocation.
(Code 1981, § 31-40; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
